column2: THEME: origami. Each numeral is a folded paper model on a washi-paper ground, its strokes built from flat folded facets (two or three tones per sheet, crisp crease lines, a sliver of the paper's coloured reverse at each fold), each sheet a different vivid paper. At rest the flaps breathe and flap on the beat like a flapping-bird model. Minute turn: the old model unfolds flat into its square sheet (the crease pattern shows), then refolds, flap after flap, into the new numeral. Hour: a sheet folds itself into a crane that flies across while the time keeps reading.

THEME: a rainbow plastic coil spring (a Slinky). Each numeral is a spring laid along the digit's path, drawn as flat overlapping coil rings in rainbow bands. At rest compression waves run along every spring on the beat, coils bunch and spread, the colours travel. Minute turn: the spring walks end over end, coil by coil like going down stairs, out of the old digit's path and into the new one. Hour: the springs cascade down a staircase and climb back as the new time.

THEME: the aurora borealis over a frozen lake and dark pines. Each numeral is an aurora curtain hung in the shape of the digit: flat bands of green fading to magenta at the hem, vertical ray strokes, folds travelling along the curtain, reflected in the lake. At rest the curtain ripples and rays brighten in a pulse on the beat. Minute turn: the old curtain drifts, folds and unfurls into the new digit's shape. Hour: a corona bursts overhead and the sky changes colour, the time still reading.

THEME: inflatable tube men (wacky waving air dancers) outside a car lot under bunting. Each numeral is an air dancer whose fabric tube bends into the digit's shape, with a silly face and flailing arms at the free ends, each in its own vivid nylon colour. At rest ripples run up every tube and they flail on the beat. Minute turn: the old dancer's blower cuts out and it sags and folds to the ground, then the new one inflates up into its digit with a whoosh. Hour: all four go wild with streamers and balloons while the time keeps reading.
